items.title: Compute hardware — rizal, ord and eureka
items.description: Three grayscale rectangular Fedora 44 host boxes arranged in a triangle: rizal above eureka and ord. Each host lists its hardware and local model paths; Gold 20TB cold storage sits below the workers, connected to their horizontal USB4/Thunderbolt local link. Revised for issue #79.
